description: Fresh training-budget validation of the 700-step scout-and-follow task: retain Candidate H exactly, but train both full and no-pheromone PPO policies for 600,000 agent transitions before the same three-seed delivery comparison.
selection_rule: No automatic winner. Candidate I can move to team review only when full-input PPO beats its same-seed separately trained no-pheromone PPO and random action on seeds 7, 17 and 27. This remains development work; Phase 2B does not start from a single seed.
required_reports: per-seed stochastic and deterministic food-delivery means
random-action reference on the same diagnostic maps
training/runtime provenance and every failed run
